claims.text: OpenAI says retained reasoning and context compaction in the Codex harness raised GPT-5.6 Sol's ARC-AGI-3 score from 13.3% to 38.3%.
OpenAI's harness-engineering team reported about 1M lines of code and about 1,500 pull requests over five months with no manually written code.
OpenAI's Agents API entered public beta on September 10, 2026, exposing the managed Codex harness behind a single API call.
The OpenAI Agents API runs the managed Codex harness with hosted, self-hosted or partner sandboxes.
OpenAI's harness-engineering team found that a single large AGENTS.md file failed.
OpenAI's harness-engineering team instead used a roughly 100-line AGENTS.md as a map pointing to a structured docs/ directory.
A ZenML case study states that every pull request at OpenAI is automatically reviewed by Codex.
OpenAI's open-source Codex harness is exposed as codex exec for bounded background jobs with structured output.
OpenAI's open-source Codex harness is also exposed through the Codex SDK.
OpenAI's open-source Codex harness is also exposed as app-server for persistent conversations with approvals.
